w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (8/11/5), with 4 wave-4 and 2 wave-5 fought, 11 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 20 · Craft 13 · Talk 23 · Explore 29 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Caleb Jones ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
